reasons.A: Closest movement: clipped past-tense first-person sentences and fragments, plain diction, short paragraphs, a generic 'you' aside and a short-long moral like the passage; the 'Then... Then...' chains lean a little thick.
reasons.B: Right plain register and short fragments, but it swings into present-tense imperative instruction ('Do not just open the valve. Listen.') and adds wry asides ('a disaster', 'I will come back to that') that the passage's quiet narrative stance lacks.
reasons.C: Long, smoothly subordinated sentences, reflective hedged tone ('slightly absurd', 'The thing that struck me most'), a colon list and 'faucet' diction: nothing like the passage's terse fragments.
